mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates stronger labor market conditions, which are associated with higher corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for UNRATE predicting 20-day SPX returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate to below 1.0% signals aggressive monetary easing, which reduces the risk-free rate and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates an accelerating economic contraction, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO falls and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a CPIAUCSL reading above 2.5% annually signals an imminent Fed tightening, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not negative in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5% during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) reflects robust consumer demand and economic activity, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for HOUST predicting 5-day SPX returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll growth rate exceeding 0.5% signals strong labor market conditions, which boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth rate > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates a severe economic contraction, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO and GDPC1 both decline.

mechanism_narrative: During post-shock recovery regimes, a rising retail sales level (RSAFS) indicates a strengthening consumer sector, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not positive in > 60% of instances during post-shock recovery when RSAFS is rising.
